label: NWM short-range forecast, unvalidated; river flow only
source: NOAA National Water Model operational short-range forecast (NWM 3.1), channel_rt, 18 hourly leads
caveats: Unvalidated: no forecast skill is claimed for this layer.
River flow only: no storm surge, tide, wave run-up, or rain/drainage flooding.
Not a closure probability. 'Scenario: flagged' means modelled flow above the reach's 10-year flow; 'not flagged' is never an all-clear.
The 10-year flows are recurrence flows of unverified provenance; the replay uses a different model version (v3.0 retrospective), so ratios are not directly comparable.
scenario_rule: RL10: flow > q10_cfs of the crossing's reach => 'scenario: flagged'. A flow level, not a probability; excludes surge, tide, wave run-up, rain/drainage flooding.

ml.reason: no ML outputs in this repo; any wiring needs its own synthetic flag and validation status
